title: What It Really Costs to Own a Koenigsegg
description:
The sticker price of a Koenigsegg Gemera starts at one point seven million dollars. That is the number everyone repeats. It is not the cost of owning one. In this video we separate what our sources actually document from what is guesswork, and we label our own arithmetic. Some of the numbers you want do not exist in public, and we say so. Our sources are Motor1, InsideHook, a March twenty twenty-six report on AOL, Wikipedia's Koenigsegg, Gemera and Regera pages, the RM Sotheby's catalogue for a twenty twenty Regera, a Jalopnik factory tour, the U.S. Energy Information Administration and the Census Bureau. One cost website, Automonitor, gives estimates with no stated sources, so we flag every number from it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

0:55 The price on the paper
2:46 The options that double down

9:47 Putting the price in human terms
11:00 The cost of waiting
12:11 Depreciation, run through the numbers
13:51 The cost per mile of a car you barely drive
15:32 A closer look at the price history
17:13 Questions buyers would ask
19:15 The sticker, rebuilt
20:37 What the sources do not say

- RM Sotheby's, 2020 Koenigsegg Regera, Monterey 2024, lot 240
